to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. OEM IMPORTED PRODUCTS: In case of imported products, OEM or Authorized Seller of OEM should have a registered office in India to provide after sales service support in India. The certificate to this effect should be submitted. 3. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing Commissioning of Goods and Training of operators and providing Statutory Clearances required (if any) 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1.The quoted brand must be a well-established Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) in India with a pro ven track record of manufacturing and supplying commercial HVAC systems for at least 7 years. 2.The equipment must strictly comply with relevant Indian Standards (IS/BIS certification) and ISO certifica tions (ISO 9001 for Quality Management and ISO 14001 for Environmental Management). 3.The Unit must be rated by the Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE) with high Indian Seasonal Energy Efficie ncy Ratio (ISEER) / Energy Efficiency Ratio (EER) suitable for heavy-duty commercial applications. 4.unit must feature a high-efficiency Heavy-Duty Tropicalizedized Inverter / Fixed-Speed Compressor (Scro ll/Rotary) engineered to operate continuously at high ambient outdoor temperatures (up to 50°C to 52°C) 5.Condenser and Evaporator coils must be 100% Inner-Grooved Copper Tube with Anti-Corrosive Blue Fins / Gold Fins coating to ensure high heat transfer rate and protection against corrosion/coastal environ ments. (Aluminium/Alloy coils will be strictly rejected). 6.The inner and outer casing of the Tower AC unit must be made of Heavy-Gauge Galvanized Steel/UV-sta bilized High-Grade Polymer with anti-rust powder coating suitable for high-footfall commercial spaces. 7.The unit must have a high-CFM centrifugal fan with long-distance air throw (minimum 12–15 meters) an d multi-directional automatic louvers for uniform air distribution. 8.If the bidder is an authorized dealer/distributor, a specific OEM Authorization Letter (MAF) issued by the OEM specifically for this tender reference number must be submitted along with the technical bid. 9.The supply includes complete installation, copper piping (specify required length(10m) inter-connecting c abling, outdoor unit mounting stand, drain pipe, and testing & commissioning. 10.Copper pipes used during installation must have a specified minimum wall thickness . Insulation must b e UV-resistant Nitrile Rubber insulation. 11.The buyer/department reserves the right to inspect the goods prior to dispatch or upon receipt at the si te for quality compliance. .
